name: Kurashiki Azusa
source:
A reserved girl with poor social skills, Azusa is a year below the protagonist and they attend the same school. Although she moved from the city two years ago, she has yet to become familiar with the town's atmosphere. She always carries a music player and listens to music by herself. Her favourite genres are punk and rock, the ones that are a tad intense. She never misses out on new releases. Her parents always work until late at night, which means she often goes out to eat. She especially loves junk food, which makes her a regular of Cafe Lakeside. She's bad at cooking, or more like, she can't cook at all.

"Senpai, I love you so much, I want to call you by your first name."

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=836910]Getchu[/url] and the [url=https://www.hibiki-site.com/products/pretty-cation2/azusa.html]official website[/url]]
